en.name: MARLI path · Level 1
en.sub: First chords and the main strum

what.en: The G/F# walk down chord

en.new: The G/F# walk down chord
en.sub: Say it “G over F sharp”. It's your G with a different bass note.
watch: Don't hit the thick low E string on the Cadd9. Mute it with your thumb, or only strum the 5 thinner strings. I prefer the thumb.
practise: G × 2 strumming patterns
G/F# × 2 strumming patterns
Cadd9 × 2 strumming patterns
G × 2 strumming patterns
Loop it slowly until it's clean.
other: Keep your ring and pinky planted on the 3rd fret for all three chords.
Same strum as Stand By Me. On the gap, keep your hand moving, just miss the strings.
Each chord gets 2 strumming patterns. This loop repeats the whole way through.
Every chord gets two lots of DDUUDU. Change chord on the last D U of the second pattern, so you're ready for the next one.

sr.sub: Izgovara se „G preko F#“. To je tvoj G sa drugim basom.
watch: Ne udaraj debelu donju E žicu na Cadd9. Priguši je palcem ili trzaj samo 5 tanjih žica. Ja više volim palac.
practise: G × 2 obrasca trzanja
G/F# × 2 obrasca trzanja
Cadd9 × 2 obrasca trzanja
G × 2 obrasca trzanja
Vrti to polako dok ne bude čisto.
other: Domali i mali prst drži na 3. pragu za sva tri akorda.
Isti ritam kao u Stand By Me. Na pauzi ruka nastavlja da se kreće, samo promaši žice.
Svaki akord dobija 2 obrasca trzanja. Ovaj krug se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.
Svaki akord dobija dva puta DDUUDU. Menjaj akord na poslednjem D U drugog obrasca, da budeš spreman za sledeći.

what.en: A new strumming pattern

en.new: A new strumming pattern
en.sub: Same strum as Stand By Me and Chasing Cars, plus a DDU DDU bit on the walk down.
watch: The new DDU DDU bit. Don't freeze, keep your rhythm hand moving.
practise: Go round the full chord progression twice.
other: Keep your ring and pinky planted on the 3rd fret for all three chords.
Use the walk down strum for the last pattern before each change.
Each box is one strumming pattern. This loop repeats the whole way through.
G and Em7 each get three full DDUUDU, then a DDU. The G/F# only gets a quick DDU before you change again. That last bit, DDU on one chord and DDU on the G/F#, is the walk down strum.

sr.sub: Isti ritam kao u Stand By Me i Chasing Cars, plus deo DDU DDU na silasku.
watch: Novi deo DDU DDU. Ne ukočuj se, ruka za ritam nek se stalno kreće.
practise: Prođi ceo niz akorda dva puta.
other: Domali i mali prst drži na 3. pragu za sva tri akorda.
Ritam za silazak sviraj kao poslednji obrazac pre svake promene.
Svaka kockica je jedan obrazac trzanja. Ovaj krug se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.
G i Em7 dobijaju po tri cela DDUUDU, pa DDU. G/F# dobija samo brzo DDU pre nego što opet menjaš. Taj poslednji deo, DDU na jednom akordu i DDU na G/F#, je ritam za silazak.

what.en: A new chord progression

en.new: A new chord progression
en.sub: You already know everything else. Same chords, same strums, just in a new order.
watch: The fast chord changes. Make sure you change during the last D U of each strumming pattern, on every chord.
practise: Play round the strumming pattern until it becomes muscle memory. Practise changing on the last D U: DDUUDU
other: Keep your ring and pinky planted on the 3rd fret for all four chords.
Same strums as Songbird. Move to the next chord on the last D U of each pattern.
Each box is one strumming pattern. This loop repeats the whole way through.
Em7, G and Cadd9 each get one full DDUUDU. Then G and G/F# share the last one: DDU on the G, DDU on the G/F#.

sr.sub: Sve ostalo već znaš. Isti akordi, isti ritmovi, samo novim redom.
watch: Brze promene akorda. Menjaj tokom poslednjeg D U svakog obrasca trzanja, na svakom akordu.
practise: Vrti obrazac trzanja dok ne uđe u ruku. Vežbaj promenu na poslednjem D U: DDUUDU
other: Domali i mali prst drži na 3. pragu za sva četiri akorda.
Isti ritmovi kao u Songbird. Prelazi na sledeći akord na poslednjem D U svakog obrasca.
Svaka kockica je jedan obrazac trzanja. Ovaj krug se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.
Em7, G i Cadd9 dobijaju po jedan ceo DDUUDU. Onda G i G/F# dele poslednji: DDU na G, DDU na G/F#.

what.en: Adding structure

en.new: Adding structure
en.sub: A chord progression for the verse and one for the chorus.
watch: The sneaky extra strumming pattern for the walk down in the chorus.
practise: Verse ×2
Chorus ×2
other: Keep your ring and pinky planted on the 3rd fret for every chord.
The verse is all main strum. In the chorus, the last pattern is the walk down strum.
Each box is one strumming pattern.
In the verse, every chord gets one full DDUUDU. In the chorus, G and G/F# share the last one: DDU on the G, DDU on the G/F#. That's the sneaky extra walk down strum.

sr.sub: Jedan niz akorda za strofu i jedan za refren.
watch: Skriveni dodatni obrazac trzanja za silazak u refrenu.
practise: Strofa ×2
Refren ×2
other: Domali i mali prst drži na 3. pragu za svaki akord.
U strofi je sve glavni ritam. U refrenu je poslednji obrazac ritam za silazak.
Svaka kockica je jedan obrazac trzanja.
U strofi svaki akord dobija jedan ceo DDUUDU. U refrenu G i G/F# dele poslednji: DDU na G, DDU na G/F#. To je onaj skriveni dodatni ritam za silazak.

what.en: New chord variations

en.new: New chord variations
en.sub: Em, Cmaj7, G and G/F# played with just your 2nd and 3rd fingers.
watch: Using other fingers to play the chords. Use the fingers numbered on the chord diagrams.
practise: Run round the chord progression twice.
other: Cmaj7 and G are the same shape. For G, shift both fingers one string over towards the thick strings.
Each chord gets one full DDDD UU DDDU.
Each box is one strumming pattern. This loop repeats the whole way through.

sr.sub: Em, Cmaj7, G i G/F# samo sa srednjim i domalim prstom.
watch: Sviranje akorda drugim prstima. Koristi prste čiji su brojevi na slikama akorda.
practise: Prođi niz akorda dva puta.
other: Cmaj7 i G su isti oblik. Za G pomeri oba prsta za jednu žicu ka debelim žicama.
Svaki akord dobija jedan ceo DDDD UU DDDU.
Svaka kockica je jedan obrazac trzanja. Ovaj krug se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.

what.en: A new strumming pattern and feel

en.new: A new strumming pattern and feel
en.sub: A swung strum, plus the normal versions of D, Em and C.
watch: Getting that swung feel right, and playing the new chords.
practise: Run round the chord progression twice.
other: It's swung, so it bounces. Long short, long short, rather than all even.
Each chord gets 2 strumming patterns. This loop repeats the whole way through.
Every chord gets two lots of DD UDU. Keep it swung: long short, long short. The gap is where your hand keeps moving but misses the strings.
Bonus chord A7: He only uses the A7 a handful of times in the song, so I don't cover it in the video. But if you want to master the song, learn this chord.

sr.sub: Ritam sa njihanjem (swing), plus obične verzije D, Em i C.
watch: Da uhvatiš taj njihajući osećaj i da odsviraš nove akorde.
practise: Prođi niz akorda dva puta.
other: Ritam se njiše, pa poskakuje. Dugo-kratko, dugo-kratko, a ne sve jednako.
Svaki akord dobija 2 obrasca trzanja. Ovaj krug se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.
Svaki akord dobija dva puta DD UDU. Neka se njiše: dugo-kratko, dugo-kratko. Na pauzi ruka nastavlja da se kreće, ali promaši žice.
Dodatni akord A7: u pesmi se pojavljuje samo par puta, pa ga ne pokazujem u videu. Ali ako hoćeš da savladaš celu pesmu, nauči i njega.

what.en: A new chord and a new strum

en.new: A new chord and a new strum
en.sub: Your first Am, plus a new strumming pattern.
watch: The change from D to Am, and D to C. Change early so you have time to switch.
practise: Go round the strumming pattern twice.
other: Am and C are one finger apart. Just move your ring finger between the A and G strings.
This whole strum covers one row of the song below.
Play the top row, then the bottom row. This repeats the whole way through.
G and D get a short D-DDU each. Am and C get the long D-DDUUDDDU. Change early on D to Am and D to C so you've got time to switch.

sr.sub: Tvoj prvi Am, plus novi obrazac trzanja.
watch: Promena sa D na Am i sa D na C. Menjaj ranije, da stigneš.
practise: Prođi obrazac trzanja dva puta.
other: Am i C se razlikuju za jedan prst. Samo pomeraj domali između A i G žice.
Ovaj ceo ritam pokriva jedan red pesme ispod.
Odsviraj gornji red, pa donji. To se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.
G i D dobijaju kratko D-DDU. Am i C dobijaju dugo D-DDUUDDDU. Menjaj ranije sa D na Am i sa D na C, da stigneš da prebaciš.

what.en: More structure

en.new: More structure
en.sub: Three sections this time: verse, chorus and bridge. Plus a new chord, Fmaj7.
watch: The bridge is the hardest chord sequence you've had to learn yet, so spend time practising that.
practise: Verse ×2
Chorus ×1
Bridge ×1
Chorus again ×1
other: Fmaj7 only comes up once, in the bridge. Two ways to play it, so pick whichever feels easier.
Same strum as I'm Yours.
Every strum is shown under the chord it goes on. Read each row left to right.

sr.sub: Ovaj put tri dela: strofa, refren i most. Plus novi akord, Fmaj7.
watch: Most je najteži niz akorda koji si do sada učio, pa odvoji vreme da ga vežbaš.
practise: Strofa ×2
Refren ×1
Most ×1
Opet refren ×1
other: Fmaj7 se javlja samo jednom, u mostu. Ima dva načina da ga sviraš, uzmi koji ti je lakši.
Isti ritam kao u I'm Yours.
Svako trzanje je ispod akorda na koji ide. Čitaj svaki red sleva nadesno.

what.en: New chords and your first riff

en.new: New chords and your first riff
en.sub: C6 and C/B, plus your first riff inside a chord progression.
watch: When playing the riff, keep your thumb muting the thick low E string.
practise: Verse ×2
Chorus ×2
other: That's the main strum. Some chords only get a DDU or a single D. Page 2 shows exactly which.
Every strum is shown under the chord it goes on. Read each row left to right.

sr.sub: C6 i C/B, plus tvoj prvi rif usred niza akorda.
watch: Dok sviraš rif, palcem i dalje prigušuj debelu donju E žicu.
practise: Strofa ×2
Refren ×2
other: To je glavni ritam. Neki akordi dobijaju samo DDU ili jedno D. Na 2. strani tačno piše koji.
Svako trzanje je ispod akorda na koji ide. Čitaj svaki red sleva nadesno.

what.en: A new picking strum, and it's faster
what.sr: Trzanje sa pojedinačnim žicama, i brže

en.new: A new picking strum, and it's faster
en.sub: Picking inside the strum, a faster tempo and faster chord changes.
watch: The speed of the song. Give yourself plenty of time to change between chords. The big one is changing strumming pattern from the end of chorus 1 into the next verse.
practise: Verse to pre chorus to chorus, non stop.
other: First time round, aim the first up at the B string and the second up at the G string.
First time round: picking strum. Second time round: basic strum, no picking.
Every strum is shown under the chord it goes on. Read each row left to right.
This song is your key to Level 2. Post it in the pinned post and once I've seen it, I'll unlock Level 2 for you.
Picking: First time round: in the DDUUDU strum, aim the first up at the B string and the second up at the G string (“pick B”, “pick G”). Second time round: basic strum, no picking.

sr.new: Trzanje sa pojedinačnim žicama, i brže
sr.sub: Pojedinačne žice usred ritma, brži tempo i brže promene akorda.
watch: Brzina pesme. Ostavi sebi dosta vremena za promene akorda. Najteže je promeniti obrazac trzanja sa kraja prvog refrena u sledeću strofu.
practise: Strofa, pa pred-refren, pa refren, bez zaustavljanja.
other: Prvi put prvi gore usmeri na B žicu, a drugi gore na G žicu.
Prvi put: ritam sa pojedinačnim žicama. Drugi put: običan ritam, bez toga.
Svako trzanje je ispod akorda na koji ide. Čitaj svaki red sleva nadesno.
Ova pesma ti otključava Nivo 2. Objavi je u zakačenoj objavi i kad je vidim, otključaću ti Nivo 2.
Prsti: Prvi put: u ritmu DDUUDU prvi gore usmeri na B žicu, a drugi gore na G žicu („B žica“, „G žica“). Drugi put: običan ritam, bez pojedinačnih žica.

courses.name: MARLI put · Nivo 2
courses.sub: Prsti, šesnaestine, Drop D, prvi barré

en.name: MARLI path · Level 2
en.sub: Fingers, 16ths, Drop D, first barré

what.en: Fast changes: Am to G to C

en.new: Fast changes: Am to G to C
en.sub: The change from Am to G, then G to C, all relatively fast.
watch: The G to C. If your fingers aren't there in time, keep your strumming hand moving anyway. Don't stop. A few messy strums is fine; stopping the rhythm isn't.
The extra C before the bridge. Everyone forgets it, so listen out for it in the play through.
The bridge. You go from one round on Am and G to two rounds on every chord. Count it in your head the first few times.
practise: The Am to G to C chord changes.
other: Fmaj7 is back from Country Roads. Play it either way.
Same strum as I'm Yours. In the single strum bit, it's just one down strum per chord.
This follows the play through in the video. On the 4th chorus, C gets two extra strumming patterns before the bridge.

sr.sub: Promena sa Am na G, pa sa G na C, sve prilično brzo.
watch: G na C. Ako prsti ne stignu na vreme, ruka za trzanje nek ipak nastavi. Ne staj. Par neurednih trzaja je u redu, prekid ritma nije.
Dodatni C pre mosta. Svi ga zaborave, pa ga osluškuj dok sviraš uz snimak.
Most. Prelaziš sa jednog kruga na Am i G na dva kruga na svakom akordu. Prvih par puta broji u sebi.
practise: Promene akorda Am, G, C.
other: Fmaj7 se vraća iz Country Roads. Sviraj ga kako god hoćeš.
Isti ritam kao u I'm Yours. U delu sa jednim trzajem ide samo jedno na dole po akordu.
Ovo prati sviranje iz videa. U 4. refrenu C dobija dva dodatna obrasca trzanja pre mosta.

what.en: Your first fingerstyle song

en.new: Your first fingerstyle song
en.sub: No strumming this time, just your thumb and fingers. Plus your first Dm.
watch: Your thumb landing on the wrong string. Every chord has its own thumb string: 2nd from the top (A) on the Am, the top E on the Em, and 3rd from the top (D) on the Dm. When you change chord, your thumb moves too. Just check where it is before you pluck.
Fingers plucking one at a time. All three go at the same time, like a little pinch.
Forgetting your fingers move on the Dm. On every other chord they stay on the same strings. On the Dm they all shift down one.
Rushing it. This is a slow, laid back song. Let the notes ring and leave a bit of space.
practise: Loop the Am, Em, G. That's the quick bit, so get that smooth and the rest will follow.
other: T is where your thumb plucks. P is the three strings your fingers pinch together.
Thumb, then your 1st, 2nd and 3rd fingers pluck together. Keep alternating the whole song.
Each T P is one go of the picking pattern. Let the notes ring and leave a bit of space.

Picking: T P: thumb plucks the bass string, then the 1st, 2nd and 3rd fingers pinch three strings together (P). Keep alternating the whole song. One T P = one go (one box). Thumb strings: Am = A string, Em = low E, G = low E, Dm = D string. Pinch strings: D G B on Am, Em and G; G B e on Dm.

sr.sub: Ovaj put bez trzanja, samo palac i prsti. Plus tvoj prvi Dm.
watch: Palac na pogrešnoj žici. Svaki akord ima svoju žicu za palac: druga odozgo (A) na Am, gornja E na Em i treća odozgo (D) na Dm. Kad promeniš akord, pomera se i palac. Samo proveri gde je pre nego što okineš.
Prsti okidaju jedan po jedan. Sva tri idu u isto vreme, kao malo štipanje.
Zaboraviš da se prsti pomeraju na Dm. Na svim ostalim akordima ostaju na istim žicama. Na Dm se svi pomere za jednu dole.
Žurba. Ovo je spora, opuštena pesma. Pusti note da zvone i ostavi malo prostora.
practise: Vrti Am, Em, G. To je brzi deo, pa kad njega izglačaš, ostalo ide samo.
other: T je gde palac okida. P su tri žice koje prsti štipnu zajedno.
Palac, pa kažiprst, srednji i domali okinu zajedno. Smenjuj to kroz celu pesmu.
Svako T P je jedan krug obrasca. Pusti note da zvone i ostavi malo prostora.

Prsti: T P: palac trza bas žicu, pa kažiprst, srednji i domali zajedno štipnu tri žice (P). Smenjuj to kroz celu pesmu. Jedno T P = jedan krug (jedna kockica). Žice za palac: Am = A žica, Em = donja E, G = donja E, Dm = D žica. Žice za štipanje: D G B na Am, Em i G; G B e na Dm.

songs.title: Have You Ever Seen The Rain

what.en: A walk down and a new G

en.new: A walk down and a new G
en.sub: Getting used to Fmaj7, the C to Am walk down, and a new way to play G.
watch: The walk down feels rushed. Each chord only gets half the pattern, so it comes round fast. Keep your strumming hand moving, even if your fingers are a bit late.
Going back to your old G. Your hand will want to play it the old way. Stick with the new shape and it'll start to feel natural.
Strumming everything at the same volume. Those harder 2nd and 4th downs are what give it the feel. Without them it sounds a bit flat.
practise: Loop the walk down: C, C/B, Am, Am7/G, half a pattern each. Once that's smooth, the chorus falls into place.
other: The walk down is just the bass note stepping down. Keep as many fingers down as you can.
A continuous DUDUDUDU. Play the downs on 2 and 4 a bit harder than the rest.
Play through: A, then B, then C. On the walk down chords you only play half the pattern, DUDU, then change.
Feel: Downs on 2 and 4 a bit harder than the rest

sr.sub: Navikavanje na Fmaj7, silazak od C do Am i novi način da sviraš G.
watch: Silazak deluje užurbano. Svaki akord dobija samo pola obrasca, pa brzo dolazi. Ruka za trzanje nek se stalno kreće, čak i ako prsti malo kasne.
Vraćanje na stari G. Ruka će htela da ga svira po starom. Drži se novog oblika i brzo će postati prirodan.
Sve trzaš istom jačinom. Ta jača na dole na 2 i 4 daju pesmi osećaj. Bez njih zvuči malo ravno.
practise: Vrti silazak: C, C/B, Am, Am7/G, svaki po pola obrasca. Kad to ide glatko, refren se sam složi.
other: Silazak je samo bas nota koja ide korak niže. Drži što više prstiju dole.
Neprekidno DUDUDUDU. Na dole na 2 i 4 sviraj malo jače od ostalih.
Redom: A, pa B, pa C. Na akordima silaska sviraš samo pola obrasca, DUDU, pa menjaš.
Osećaj: Na dole na 2 i 4 malo jače od ostalih

what.en: Counting to 6, and a new chord

en.new: Counting to 6, and a new chord
en.sub: A new strumming count, a long chord progression, and B7 in the chorus.
watch: The B7. It's a new shape and it's a stretch. Take your time with it, and it'll get easier the more you go between it and the Em.
Losing the count. We're counting to 6 now, not 4. If you get lost, count it out loud.
The 4th time in the chorus. It's easy to keep going Em, B7 and miss the change. Remember: three times round, then it changes.
Rushing it. This is a slow, gentle song. All those down strums can make you speed up without noticing.
practise: Loop the Em to B7. That's the new change, and it's the bit the whole chorus is built on.
other: Try Fmaj7 with your thumb (T) on the low E. Too much for now? Use the Riptide version.
Count to 6, not 4. Only down strums, and hit the 1 and the 4 a bit harder than the rest.
Every group of 6 arrows is one lot of DDDDDD. After the chorus, go back to the verse.
Feel: Hit the 1 and the 4 a bit harder than the rest

sr.sub: Novo brojanje za trzanje, dug niz akorda i B7 u refrenu.
watch: B7. Novi oblik i treba istegnuti prste. Ne žuri, biće sve lakše što ga više budeš menjao sa Em.
Gubljenje brojanja. Sad brojimo do 6, ne do 4. Ako se izgubiš, broji naglas.
Četvrti put u refrenu. Lako je nastaviti Em, B7 i propustiti promenu. Zapamti: tri kruga, pa promena.
Žurba. Ovo je spora, nežna pesma. Od tolikih trzaja na dole lako ubrzaš a da ne primetiš.
practise: Vrti Em na B7. To je nova promena i na njoj stoji ceo refren.
other: Probaj Fmaj7 sa palcem (T) na donjoj E. Previše za sad? Koristi verziju iz Riptide.
Broji do 6, ne do 4. Samo trzaji na dole, a 1 i 4 udari malo jače od ostalih.
Svaka grupa od 6 strelica je jedan DDDDDD. Posle refrena se vrati na strofu.
Osećaj: 1 i 4 udari malo jače od ostalih

what.en: Two ways to play it, and two new chords
what.sr: Dve deonice i dva nova akorda

en.new: Two ways to play it, and two new chords
en.sub: The main part and Tom Petty's part. Gsus2 and Asus4 are new, but they're both easy ones.
watch: Changing on the beat instead of just before it. Your hand will want to wait for the beat. The chord comes in a touch early, and that's the whole feel of the song.
Stopping your strumming hand in the gaps. Keep it moving, even when you're not hitting the strings, or the ups won't land in the right place.
Losing your place. Because it repeats so much, it's easy to drift. Keep an ear on the song so you know where you are.
Rushing. It's got a steady, rolling feel, so don't let it run away from you.
practise: Loop the chord progression around slowly until you can play it without thinking too hard.
other: Capo on the 3rd fret. This is the one you post, and it repeats the whole way through the song.
The chords change just before the beat, not on it. That's what gives it the bounce. Let the long ones ring.
Keep your strumming hand moving up and down the whole time, even when you're not hitting the strings.
Post the main part, the one with the capo on the 3rd fret.
Feel: Chords change just before the beat (on the “&” of 1 or 2), not on it. Let the long ones ring.

sr.new: Dve deonice i dva nova akorda
sr.sub: Glavna deonica i deonica koju svira Tom Petty. Gsus2 i Asus4 su novi, ali oba su laka.
watch: Menjaš na dobu umesto malo pre nje. Ruka će hteti da čeka dobu. Akord ulazi za dlaku ranije, i u tome je ceo osećaj pesme.
Ruka za trzanje staje u pauzama. Nek se kreće i kad ne udaraš žice, inače trzaji na gore neće pasti na pravo mesto.
Gubiš se. Pošto se toliko ponavlja, lako odlutaš. Osluškuj pesmu da znaš gde si.
Žurba. Pesma ima ujednačen, kotrljajući osećaj, ne daj joj da ti pobegne.
practise: Vrti niz akorda polako dok ne budeš mogao da ga sviraš bez mnogo razmišljanja.
other: Kapodaster na 3. pragu. Ovu deonicu objavljuješ, i ona se ponavlja kroz celu pesmu.
Akordi se menjaju malo pre doba, ne na njemu. Od toga pesma poskakuje. Duge pusti da zvone.
Ruka za trzanje nek se stalno kreće gore-dole, čak i kad ne udaraš žice.
Objavi glavnu deonicu, onu sa kapodasterom na 3. pragu.
Osećaj: Akordi se menjaju malo pre doba (na „i“ posle 1 ili 2), ne na njemu. Duge pusti da zvone.

what.en: A new strumming pattern

en.new: A new strumming pattern
en.sub: Your strumming hand never stops. Plus a new chord: the Wonderwall Asus4.
watch: The Cadd9, Dsus4, Asus4 bit before verse 2. It only happens once and doesn't repeat again.
The fast changing bit in the pre chorus. It's the hardest part of the song, and it's right before the chorus, so you don't want to mess it up there.
practise: Go round the fast changing bit in the pre chorus more than any other part of the song: Cadd9, Dsus4, G, walk down, Em7, G, Asus4.
other: Keep your ring and pinky planted on the 3rd fret for every chord in this song.
Dark and orange arrows, you hit the strings. Grey arrows, your hand still moves but misses. Keep your hand going down and up the whole time, like a pendulum.
Really important: this bit only happens once, in between verse 1 and verse 2. It doesn't repeat again.
Last Em7: one strum and let it ring for 6 counts. Asus4 comes in on 7. Then you're back into the verse and the song repeats.

sr.sub: Ruka za trzanje nikad ne staje. Plus novi akord: Asus4 iz Wonderwall.
watch: Deo Cadd9, Dsus4, Asus4 pre druge strofe. Javlja se samo jednom i više se ne ponavlja.
Deo sa brzim promenama u pred-refrenu. To je najteži deo pesme, i dolazi baš pred refren, pa tu ne želiš da pogrešiš.
practise: Deo sa brzim promenama u pred-refrenu vežbaj više od svega ostalog: Cadd9, Dsus4, G, silazak, Em7, G, Asus4.
other: Domali i mali prst drži na 3. pragu za svaki akord u ovoj pesmi.
Tamne i narandžaste strelice: udaraš žice. Sive strelice: ruka se i dalje kreće, ali promaši. Ruka nek ide dole-gore sve vreme, kao klatno.
Važno: ovaj deo se javlja samo jednom, između prve i druge strofe. Više se ne ponavlja.
Poslednji Em7: jedan trzaj i pusti ga da zvoni dok izbrojiš 6. Asus4 ulazi na 7. Onda si opet u strofi i pesma se ponavlja.

what.en: Drop D, tabs and playing up the neck
what.sr: Drop D, tabulature i sviranje više na vratu

en.new: Drop D, tabs and playing up the neck
en.sub: A new tuning, your first tab, and chord shapes further up the neck.
watch: Forgetting the tuning. Check your thickest string is down to D before you start.
Reading the tab upside down. The bottom line is your thickest string.
Rushing it. The feel matters more than the speed here.
practise: Loop the riff in Part A until the three shapes flow into each other. Then listen to the record a bunch of times and play along.
other: Turn your thickest string down from E to D. Play it next to your D string (3rd from the thickest) and keep turning until they sound the same, just lower.
The famous Harvest Moon riff. Play it 4 times for the intro, and come back to it between the other parts.
Each line is a string. The bottom line is your thickest string, the top line your thinnest.
Keep it swung and keep your strumming hand moving the whole song.
The orange D is your drop D string. G is the same shape as Em, moved up to the 5th fret.
Each group of arrows is one go of DDDUDU. A7sus4 to A7: leave your 1st finger where it is, put your 2nd finger on the B string, lift your 3rd finger off.
The feel comes from the record. Watch the lesson, learn the parts, then listen to the song and play along with Neil.

Picking: Part A riff (TAB, drop D). Shape 1: low D 0, A 0, D 0, G 11, B 10 (2nd finger G 11, 1st finger B 10). Shape 2: add 3rd finger on B 12 (G 11, B 12). Shape 3: move over, 3rd finger G 11, 2nd B 10, 1st e 9. Strum the riff D U D U D U D U: first D on the thick string, the rest on the thin strings to bring out the melody. Riff bars are written as D in the song text.
Feel: Riff: first down on the thick string, the ups and downs after it on the thin strings.

sr.new: Drop D, tabulature i sviranje više na vratu
sr.sub: Novo štimovanje, tvoja prva tabulatura i oblici akorda više na vratu.
watch: Zaboraviš štimovanje. Pre početka proveri da je najdeblja žica spuštena na D.
Čitaš tabulaturu naopako. Donja linija je tvoja najdeblja žica.
Žurba. Ovde je osećaj važniji od brzine.
practise: Vrti rif iz dela A dok tri oblika ne počnu da se prelivaju jedan u drugi. Onda poslušaj snimak više puta i sviraj uz njega.
other: Spusti najdeblju žicu sa E na D. Sviraj je uz D žicu (treću od najdeblje) i okreći dok ne zvuče isto, samo niže.
Čuveni rif iz Harvest Moon. Sviraj ga 4 puta za uvod i vraćaj mu se između ostalih delova.
Svaka linija je jedna žica. Donja linija je najdeblja žica, gornja najtanja.
Nek se njiše, i ruka za trzanje nek se kreće kroz celu pesmu.
Narandžasto D je tvoja drop D žica. G je isti oblik kao Em, pomeren na 5. prag.
Svaka grupa strelica je jedan DDDUDU. Sa A7sus4 na A7: kažiprst ostavi gde je, srednji stavi na B žicu, domali podigni.
Osećaj dolazi sa snimka. Pogledaj lekciju, nauči delove, pa slušaj pesmu i sviraj zajedno sa Neilom.

Prsti: Rif u delu A (TAB, drop D). Oblik 1: donja D 0, A 0, D 0, G 11, B 10 (srednji prst G 11, kažiprst B 10). Oblik 2: dodaj domali na B 12 (G 11, B 12). Oblik 3: pomeri se, domali G 11, srednji B 10, kažiprst e 9. Rif trzaj D U D U D U D U: prvo D na debeloj žici, ostalo na tankim žicama da se čuje melodija. Taktovi sa rifom su u tekstu pesme napisani kao D.
Osećaj: Rif: prvo na dole na debeloj žici, a gore i dole posle toga na tankim žicama.

what.en: Your first barre chord

en.new: Your first barre chord
en.sub: Bm, plus your first riff. It'll feel hard and probably buzz at first. That's completely normal.
watch: The Bm buzzing. Roll your 1st finger slightly onto its side, keep it close to the fret, and squeeze with your thumb.
Hitting the thickest string on the Bm. Start your strum from the next one down.
Getting back to the Bm in time. If you're late, keep your strumming hand going and catch up.
Your hand getting tired or sore. That's normal. Take breaks, little and often.
The note dying on the slide. Keep pressing down while you slide.
practise: Put the Bm on and take it off. Make the shape, let go, make it again. Then do A to Bm and E to Bm. The quicker you can find the barre, the easier the whole song gets.
other: HOW TO PLAY THE BM: Make your Am shape with your 2nd, 3rd and 4th fingers, then move it up 2 frets. Lay your 1st finger across the 2nd fret, from the A string down. Don't play the thickest string. Use the side of your 1st finger, the bony side, not the soft part. Thumb in the middle of the back of the neck, and squeeze. Start with just the 1st finger on the 2nd fret and get those strings ringing, then add the rest.
Embellishments (optional): You don't have to add these. They just make it sound a bit cooler and more like the record. The Esus4 matters more than the Asus4, which you know from Free Fallin'.
DD DUDU. Accent the 2nd down. On the Bm, the first down starts from the A string, not the thickest.
Each group of arrows is one go of DD DUDU. Add the Esus4 and Asus4 in if you want to.
Play through: Chords ×2, Stop (count in 1, 2, 3), Riff over the backing track ×2.

Picking: THE RIFF (single notes, starts on the B string): B 0, 7, 7, \0 (slide down), 0, 7, 7, 5, 3, 2, 0, then D 4 (ring finger), G 2 (1st finger), G 1. \ means slide down. Keep pressing down while you slide, or the note will stop. Played over the backing track.
Feel: Accent the 2nd down. First down on the thick strings; on the Bm the first down starts from the A string, not the thickest.

sr.sub: Bm, plus tvoj prvi rif. U početku će biti teško i verovatno će zujati. To je sasvim normalno.
watch: Bm zuji. Kažiprst malo okreni na bok, drži ga blizu praga i stegni palcem.
Udaraš najdeblju žicu na Bm. Kreni trzaj od sledeće.
Ne stižeš na Bm. Ako kasniš, ruka za trzanje nek nastavi, pa sustigni.
Ruka se umori ili boli. To je normalno. Pravi pauze, malo i često.
Nota zamire tokom klizanja. Pritiskaj žicu dok klizaš.
practise: Stavljaj i skidaj Bm. Napravi oblik, pusti, napravi ponovo. Onda A na Bm i E na Bm. Što brže nađeš barré, to je cela pesma lakša.
other: KAKO SE SVIRA BM: napravi oblik Am srednjim, domalim i malim prstom, pa ga pomeri 2 praga više. Kažiprst položi preko 2. praga, od A žice nadole. Najdeblju žicu ne sviraj. Koristi bok kažiprsta, koščatu stranu, ne meki deo. Palac na sredinu poleđine vrata, i stegni. Počni samo sa kažiprstom na 2. pragu dok te žice ne zazvone, pa dodaj ostalo.
Ukrasi (nije obavezno): ne moraš da ih dodaješ. Samo zvuči malo bolje i više kao na snimku. Esus4 je važniji od Asus4, koji znaš iz Free Fallin'.
DD DUDU. Naglasi drugo na dole. Na Bm prvo na dole kreće od A žice, ne od najdeblje.
Svaka grupa strelica je jedan DD DUDU. Dodaj Esus4 i Asus4 ako hoćeš.
Redom: akordi ×2, stop (odbroj 1, 2, 3), rif uz prateću matricu ×2.

Prsti: RIF (pojedinačne note, počinje na B žici): B 0, 7, 7, \0 (klizanje na dole), 0, 7, 7, 5, 3, 2, 0, pa D 4 (domali), G 2 (kažiprst), G 1. \ znači klizanje na dole. Pritiskaj žicu dok klizaš, inače nota prestane. Svira se uz prateću matricu.
Osećaj: Naglasi drugo na dole. Prvo na dole po debelim žicama; na Bm prvo na dole kreće od A žice, ne od najdeblje.

what.en: More Bm practice, and a fancy new chord
what.sr: Još vežbe za Bm i novi zanimljiv akord

en.new: More Bm practice, and a fancy new chord
en.sub: A great workout for your Bm barre, plus D#dim. Don't worry about the name.
watch: Changing too early. On Em to A and D to Bm, the change lands on the 2nd up, not the 1st.
Getting the Bm down in time. If you're late, keep your strumming hand moving and catch up.
practise: D to Bm as much as you can, with the strumming pattern.
Then Part C with the new D#dim chord.
other: D#dim: take your D chord, move every finger one string thicker and back 1 fret, then add your pinky to the 2nd fret of the thin e string.
B7: from the D#dim, move your middle finger to the 2nd fret of the A string. The other fingers stay put.
DDDUD UUDDUDU. It changes a little in places, but it mainly stays around this. On Em to A and D to Bm, the chord changes on the 2nd up.
Then back to Part A. The orange arrows are ups. In Parts A and B, the change lands on the 2nd up of the pattern.
The song changes key later on, but we're just learning the first key.

sr.new: Još vežbe za Bm i novi zanimljiv akord
sr.sub: Odlična vežba za tvoj Bm barré, plus D#dim. Ne brini zbog imena.
watch: Prerano menjaš. Na Em na A i D na Bm promena pada na drugo gore, ne na prvo.
Ne stižeš da staviš Bm. Ako kasniš, ruka za trzanje nek nastavi, pa sustigni.
practise: D na Bm što više možeš, sa obrascem trzanja.
Onda deo C sa novim akordom D#dim.
other: D#dim: uzmi akord D, pomeri svaki prst jednu žicu ka debljoj i jedan prag nazad, pa dodaj mali prst na 2. prag tanke e žice.
B7: sa D#dim pomeri srednji prst na 2. prag A žice. Ostali prsti ostaju gde su.
DDDUD UUDDUDU. Ponegde se malo menja, ali uglavnom ostaje ovako. Na Em na A i D na Bm akord se menja na drugo gore.
Pa nazad na deo A. Narandžaste strelice su trzaji na gore. U delovima A i B promena pada na drugo gore u obrascu.
Pesma kasnije menja tonalitet, ali mi učimo samo prvi.

what.en: Two strumming patterns, 8 chords each

en.new: Two strumming patterns, 8 chords each
en.sub: The longest song so far. The good news: you already know every chord.
watch: Learn the chord order first. Forget the strumming for a bit. Play one strum on each chord and let it ring, until you can get through the verse without looking at the sheet. Then the chorus. Once you know the order, the strumming slots straight back in.
Use the lyrics. Each line of the song has its own chords. Sing it, hum it, or say the words in your head while you play, and the song tells you where you are.
Loop the hard bits on their own. Find the two or three changes you struggle with and play just those until they're smooth. Same with the verse into the chorus, where the strumming changes too.
Keep your strumming hand moving. You're going to be late sometimes, and that's fine. Miss a strum and catch up on the next chord. Just don't stop.
practise: And don't try to get it all in one go. Get the verse solid, then the chorus, then put them together.
Practise both strums over just an Am first.
other: Dark and orange arrows hit the strings. Grey arrows, your hand moves but misses.
Verse: on the first up you hit, aim for the B string, like Good Riddance. On the 3, do a big strum all the way to the thick E string. Practise both over just an Am first.
Each chord gets one full bar. The strumming pattern changes when you go from the verse into the chorus.

Level 3 is where it gets really good. These are the songs that'll take you from a beginner to an intermediate player. By the end of it, you won't just be someone learning guitar, you'll be a guitarist.
This song is your key to Level 3. Post it and I'll unlock it for you.
Feel: Verse: on the first up you hit, aim for the B string (like Good Riddance). On the 3, a big strum all the way to the thick E string.

sr.sub: Najduža pesma do sada. Dobra vest: već znaš svaki akord.
watch: Prvo nauči redosled akorda. Zaboravi na trzanje na neko vreme. Odsviraj jedan trzaj na svakom akordu i pusti ga da zvoni, dok ne prođeš strofu bez gledanja u papir. Pa refren. Kad znaš redosled, trzanje se samo vrati na mesto.
Koristi tekst. Svaki stih pesme ima svoje akorde. Pevaj, pevuši ili izgovaraj reči u sebi dok sviraš, i pesma će ti reći gde si.
Teške delove vrti posebno. Nađi dve-tri promene koje ti ne idu i sviraj samo njih dok ne budu glatke. Isto i za prelaz iz strofe u refren, gde se menja i trzanje.
Ruka za trzanje nek se stalno kreće. Ponekad ćeš kasniti, i to je u redu. Propusti trzaj i sustigni na sledećem akordu. Samo ne staj.
practise: I ne pokušavaj sve odjednom. Učvrsti strofu, pa refren, pa ih spoji.
Prvo vežbaj oba ritma samo na Am.
other: Tamne i narandžaste strelice udaraju žice. Sive strelice: ruka se kreće, ali promaši.
Strofa: prvi trzaj na gore koji udaraš usmeri na B žicu, kao u Good Riddance. Na 3, veliki trzaj sve do debele E žice. Oba prvo vežbaj samo na Am.
Svaki akord dobija ceo takt. Obrazac trzanja se menja kad iz strofe pređeš u refren.
Nivo 3 je mesto gde postaje stvarno dobro. Ovo su pesme koje će te od početnika dovesti do srednjeg nivoa. Na kraju nećeš biti samo neko ko uči gitaru, bićeš gitarista.
Ova pesma ti otključava Nivo 3. Objavi je i otključaću ti ga.
Osećaj: Strofa: prvi trzaj na gore koji udaraš usmeri na B žicu (kao u Good Riddance). Na 3, veliki trzaj sve do debele E žice.

en.name: MARLI path · Level 3
en.sub: Barré, riffs, Travis picking

what.en: The Fast Car riff

en.new: The Fast Car riff
en.sub: Fingerpicked with your thumb, 1st and 2nd fingers, with shapes that move up the neck.
watch: The quick change in the chorus. C only gets D D, so be ready to change on the up.
Losing your place in the riff. Say the shape numbers in your head as you go.
Shapes 5 and 6. Check the fret number before you put your fingers down.
practise: Loop the riff on its own until it flows, nice and slow. Then loop the chorus, C D D into Em.
other: Play them in order, 1 to 6. Frets are counted from the capo.
Pick it with your thumb, 1st and 2nd fingers. Your thumb takes the thicker strings and your fingers take the thinner ones. Shapes 5 and 6 are up the neck, so look for the fret number next to them.
DDUUDU, the Stand By Me strum. In the chorus, some chords only get half of it.
In the chorus, C only gets the first D D, then you change on the up. Back to the riff once after the chorus.

Picking: THE RIFF: play the 6 riff shapes in order, 1 to 6 (frets counted from the capo). Pick with your thumb, 1st and 2nd fingers: thumb takes the thicker strings, fingers the thinner ones. Shape 1: A 3 (3rd finger), D 2 (2nd). Shape 2: A 3, D 2, B 1 (1st). Shape 3: A 3, D 2 (same as shape 1). Shape 4: E 3 (2nd), A 2 (1st), B 3 (3rd), e 3 (4th). Shape 5 (7fr): A 7 (1st), B 8 (3rd). Shape 6 (5fr): A 5 (1st), B 7 (3rd). Only the fretted notes are drawn; which strings are picked is in the video.

sr.sub: Svira se prstima, palcem, kažiprstom i srednjim, sa oblicima koji idu uz vrat.
watch: Brza promena u refrenu. C dobija samo D D, pa budi spreman da menjaš na gore.
Gubiš se u rifu. Izgovaraj brojeve oblika u sebi dok sviraš.
Oblici 5 i 6. Proveri broj praga pre nego što spustiš prste.
practise: Vrti sam rif dok ne poteče, lepo polako. Onda vrti refren, C D D u Em.
other: Sviraj ih redom, od 1 do 6. Pragovi se broje od kapodastera.
Sviraj palcem, kažiprstom i srednjim. Palac uzima deblje žice, a prsti tanje. Oblici 5 i 6 su više na vratu, pa gledaj broj praga pored njih.
DDUUDU, ritam iz Stand By Me. U refrenu neki akordi dobijaju samo pola.
U refrenu C dobija samo prvo D D, pa menjaš na gore. Posle refrena jednom nazad na rif.

Prsti: RIF: sviraj 6 oblika rifa redom, od 1 do 6 (pragovi se broje od kapodastera). Sviraj palcem, kažiprstom i srednjim: palac uzima deblje žice, prsti tanje. Oblik 1: A 3 (domali), D 2 (srednji). Oblik 2: A 3, D 2, B 1 (kažiprst). Oblik 3: A 3, D 2 (isto kao oblik 1). Oblik 4: E 3 (srednji), A 2 (kažiprst), B 3 (domali), e 3 (mali). Oblik 5 (7. prag): A 7 (kažiprst), B 8 (domali). Oblik 6 (5. prag): A 5 (kažiprst), B 7 (domali). Nacrtane su samo pritisnute note; koje žice se sviraju vidi se u videu.

what.en: A new tuning and open barre shapes
what.sr: Novo štimovanje i otvoreni barré oblici

en.new: A new tuning and open barre shapes
en.sub: Your thinnest string goes down to D#, and the B and D# strings ring open on every chord.
watch: Forgetting the tuning. Check your thin string is down to D# before you start.
Touching the open strings. Keep your fingers arched so the B and D# ring out.
The thumb chords. Hook your thumb over the top of the neck onto the thick E string.
practise: The chorus change: E to G#m to F#. Slide the shape down 2 frets from G#m to F#, keeping your thumb hooked over.
other: Turn your thinnest string down a little, from E to D#. To check it, play the B string at the 4th fret. Your open thin string should sound the same.
Verse: 1st finger on the thick E string, then the same shape with your 2nd, 3rd and 4th fingers. Leave the B and D# strings open on every chord.
Chorus: G#m and F# use your thumb (T) on the thick E string. E uses your 3rd, 4th and 2nd fingers.
DDDDU, the same pattern the whole way through.
Each group of arrows is one go of DDDDU. At the end of the chorus, one strum on the E and let it ring for 2, 3, 4, then back to the intro / verse.
The original tunes the thinnest string down to D#. Here it is in standard tuning — it sounds good this way too.

sr.new: Novo štimovanje i otvoreni barré oblici
sr.sub: Najtanja žica ide dole na D#, a B i D# žica zvone otvoreno na svakom akordu.
watch: Zaboraviš štimovanje. Pre početka proveri da je tanka žica spuštena na D#.
Dodiruješ otvorene žice. Drži prste povijene da B i D# zvone.
Akordi sa palcem. Prebaci palac preko vrha vrata na debelu E žicu.
practise: Promena u refrenu: E na G#m na F#. Sa G#m na F# klizni oblikom 2 praga niže, a palac drži prebačen.
other: Spusti najtanju žicu malo, sa E na D#. Proveri ovako: odsviraj B žicu na 4. pragu. Otvorena tanka žica treba da zvuči isto.
Strofa: kažiprst na debeloj E žici, pa isti oblik srednjim, domalim i malim prstom. B i D# žicu ostavi otvorene na svakom akordu.
Refren: G#m i F# koriste palac (T) na debeloj E žici. E se svira domalim, malim i srednjim prstom.
DDDDU, isti obrazac kroz celu pesmu.
Svaka grupa strelica je jedan DDDDU. Na kraju refrena jedan trzaj na E i pusti ga da zvoni na 2, 3, 4, pa nazad na uvod / strofu.
U originalu je najtanja žica spuštena na D#. Ovde je standardno štimovanje — i ovako zvuči dobro.

strum.name: Thumb picking T 1 T 1 T 1 T 1

what.en: F#m and a thumb picking pattern

en.new: F#m and a thumb picking pattern
en.sub: A new barre chord, plus a gentle pattern with your thumb and 1st finger.
watch: The F#m buzzing. Roll your 1st finger onto its side and squeeze with your thumb, just like the Bm.
Your thumb drifting. It plays the lowest string of each chord, so it moves when the chord changes.
Rushing. It's a slow, gentle song. Keep your thumb steady like a heartbeat.
practise: D to F#m and back, with the picking pattern. It's the first change in the song and it comes round all the time.
other: F#m: it's your Em shape with your 3rd and 4th fingers, moved up 2 frets, then your 1st finger laid across the 2nd fret on all six strings. Same bony side of the finger and thumb squeeze as your Bm.
Each box is one bar of T 1 T 1 T 1 T 1. The last two chords of the verse, Bm and A, get half a bar each.

Picking: T 1 T 1 T 1 T 1 on 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. T = your thumb plays the bass note, the lowest string of the chord, on every beat. 1 = your 1st finger flicks up across the thin strings on every “and”. Keep it steady and gentle, one bar per chord.

sr.sub: Novi barré akord, plus nežan obrazac palcem i kažiprstom.
watch: F#m zuji. Kažiprst okreni na bok i stegni palcem, isto kao kod Bm.
Palac luta. Svira najnižu žicu svakog akorda, pa se pomera kad se akord menja.
Žurba. Spora je i nežna pesma. Palac nek kuca ujednačeno kao srce.
practise: D na F#m i nazad, sa obrascem. To je prva promena u pesmi i stalno se vraća.
other: F#m: to je tvoj oblik Em domalim i malim prstom, pomeren 2 praga više, pa kažiprst položen preko 2. praga na svih šest žica. Ista koščata strana prsta i stisak palcem kao kod Bm.
Svaka kockica je jedan takt T 1 T 1 T 1 T 1. Poslednja dva akorda strofe, Bm i A, dobijaju po pola takta.
Prsti: T 1 T 1 T 1 T 1 na 1 i 2 i 3 i 4 i. T = palac svira bas notu, najnižu žicu akorda, na svaku dobu. 1 = kažiprst okrzne nagore tanke žice na svako „i“. Ujednačeno i nežno, jedan takt po akordu.

what.en: One finger power chords in drop D
what.sr: Kvintni akordi jednim prstom u drop D

en.new: One finger power chords in drop D
en.sub: An electric song on acoustic. Fast, constant strumming on the three thickest strings.
watch: Forgetting the tuning. Check the thickest string is down to D.
Hitting the thin strings. Only strum the three thickest ones.
Stopping your strumming hand on the changes. It keeps going, even while your fretting hand moves.
practise: The verse loop on its own, until sliding between the 9th and 5th frets feels easy. Then the chorus, B5 to G5 to D5.
other: Same as Harvest Moon. Turn your thickest string down from E to D, until it matches your D string (3rd from the thickest), just lower.
Bsus2 and Gsus2 are the same shape. Slide it between the 9th and 5th frets.
In drop D, one finger flat across the three thickest strings makes a power chord. D5 is just the three open strings.
Constant DUDUDUDU, only hitting the three thickest strings. Never stop that hand.
Each box is one bar of constant DUDUDUDU. The verse shapes ring out more, the chorus power chords hit harder.
Feel: Only hit the three thickest strings. The verse shapes ring out more, the chorus power chords hit harder.

sr.new: Kvintni akordi jednim prstom u drop D
sr.sub: Električna pesma na akustičnoj. Brzo, neprekidno trzanje po tri najdeblje žice.
watch: Zaboraviš štimovanje. Proveri da je najdeblja žica spuštena na D.
Udaraš tanke žice. Trzaj samo tri najdeblje.
Ruka za trzanje staje na promenama. Ona nastavlja, i dok se druga ruka pomera.
practise: Samo krug iz strofe, dok klizanje između 9. i 5. praga ne postane lako. Onda refren, B5 na G5 na D5.
other: Isto kao u Harvest Moon. Spusti najdeblju žicu sa E na D, dok ne zvuči kao D žica (treća od najdeblje), samo niže.
Bsus2 i Gsus2 su isti oblik. Klizi njime između 9. i 5. praga.
U drop D jedan prst položen preko tri najdeblje žice daje kvintni akord. D5 su samo tri otvorene žice.
Neprekidno DUDUDUDU, udaraš samo tri najdeblje žice. Ta ruka nikad ne staje.
Svaka kockica je jedan takt neprekidnog DUDUDUDU. Oblici u strofi više zvone, kvintni akordi u refrenu udaraju jače.
Osećaj: Udaraj samo tri najdeblje žice. Oblici u strofi više zvone, kvintni akordi u refrenu udaraju jače.

what.en: Your first arpeggio picking pattern

en.new: Your first arpeggio picking pattern
en.sub: Picking the strings one at a time instead of together, counted in 6. In the key of G.
watch: Counting in 4. This one's in 6, like Can't Help Falling In Love.
Your thumb drifting. It plays the lowest string of each chord, so it moves when the chord changes.
Cutting notes short. Keep your chord held down so every note keeps ringing.
practise: T 1 2 3 2 1 over just a G until it feels smooth.
Then the end of the verse: C, D, B7, Em.
other: Every chord is one you know. B7 is the one from Can't Help Falling In Love, and it only comes up once in each verse.
Each box is one go of T 1 2 3 2 1. After the chorus, go back to the verse.

Picking: T 1 2 3 2 1, counted 1 to 6, one go per chord. T = your thumb on the bass note, the lowest string of the chord. 1 = 1st finger on the G string. 2 = 2nd finger on the B string. 3 = 3rd finger on the thin e string. It goes up and back down.

sr.sub: Žice jednu po jednu umesto zajedno, uz brojanje do 6. U tonalitetu G.
watch: Brojiš do 4. Ova je u 6, kao Can't Help Falling In Love.
Palac luta. Svira najnižu žicu svakog akorda, pa se pomera kad se akord menja.
Skraćuješ note. Drži akord pritisnut da svaka nota i dalje zvoni.
practise: T 1 2 3 2 1 samo na G dok ne bude glatko.
Onda kraj strofe: C, D, B7, Em.
other: Svaki akord već znaš. B7 je onaj iz Can't Help Falling In Love i javlja se samo jednom u svakoj strofi.
Svaka kockica je jedan krug T 1 2 3 2 1. Posle refrena se vrati na strofu.

Prsti: T 1 2 3 2 1, broji se od 1 do 6, jedan krug po akordu. T = palac na bas noti, najnižoj žici akorda. 1 = kažiprst na G žici. 2 = srednji na B žici. 3 = domali na tankoj e žici. Ide gore pa nazad dole.

what.en: Capo high up the neck, and a tricky bridge

en.new: Capo high up the neck, and a tricky bridge
en.sub: Capo on the 7th fret for that bright sound, chords you know, and a bridge with uneven timing.
watch: The bridge timing. It doesn't fit neatly into counts of 4, so listen to the record and follow it.
The E7 in the chorus. It comes in quick after the G.
Strumming too hard. With the capo this high it sounds best light and bright.
practise: The bridge on its own: Fmaj7, C, G, D, A7, round and round with the record until the timing feels natural.
other: Every shape is one you know. Count the frets from the capo. Fmaj7 and C only come in the bridge.
The Stand By Me strum, light and bouncy. One go per chord box.
Each box is one go of the strum. In the bridge, follow the record rather than counting, the chords don't all last the same.
Feel: Light and bright, not hard

sr.sub: Kapodaster na 7. pragu za taj svetao zvuk, akordi koje znaš i most sa neravnim trajanjem.
watch: Tajming u mostu. Ne uklapa se lepo u brojanje do 4, pa slušaj snimak i prati ga.
E7 u refrenu. Dolazi brzo posle G.
Prejako trzanje. Sa kapodasterom ovako visoko najbolje zvuči lagano i svetlo.
practise: Sam most: Fmaj7, C, G, D, A7, ukrug uz snimak dok tajming ne postane prirodan.
other: Svaki oblik već znaš. Pragove broji od kapodastera. Fmaj7 i C dolaze samo u mostu.
Ritam iz Stand By Me, lagano i razigrano. Jedan krug po kockici akorda.
Svaka kockica je jedan krug ritma. U mostu prati snimak umesto brojanja, akordi ne traju svi isto.
Osećaj: Lagano i svetlo, ne jako

what.en: Lead guitar and chords together

en.new: Lead guitar and chords together
en.sub: The famous intro lick in between the chords, plus D/F# with your thumb on the thick E string.
watch: Rushing the lick. Get the chords solid first, then add it in once you can play them without thinking.
The D/F# thumb. Hook it over the top of the neck and keep the A string quiet.
Losing your ring and pinky on the intro. Leave them planted between Em7, G and A7sus4.
practise: The verse change C to D/F# to Am. That's where the thumb comes in, and it comes round twice in every verse.
other: Em7, G and A7sus4 all keep your ring and pinky planted on the 3rd fret. D/F#: thumb (T) on the 2nd fret of the thick E string.
The Stand By Me strum, one go per chord box. Keep it relaxed, this song is laid back.
Each box is one go of the strum. The intro chords come back as the solo section in the middle.
Picking: The intro lick (lead guitar between the chords) is taught in the video; it is not written on the sheet.
Feel: Keep it relaxed, this song is laid back.

sr.sub: Čuveni lik iz uvoda između akorda, plus D/F# sa palcem na debeloj E žici.
watch: Žuriš sa likom. Prvo učvrsti akorde, pa ga dodaj kad ih sviraš bez razmišljanja.
Palac na D/F#. Prebaci ga preko vrha vrata i drži A žicu tihom.
Gubiš domali i mali prst u uvodu. Ostavi ih na mestu između Em7, G i A7sus4.
practise: Promena u strofi C na D/F# na Am. Tu dolazi palac, i to dva puta u svakoj strofi.
other: Em7, G i A7sus4 svi drže domali i mali prst na 3. pragu. D/F#: palac (T) na 2. pragu debele E žice.
Ritam iz Stand By Me, jedan krug po kockici akorda. Opušteno, ova pesma je lagana.
Svaka kockica je jedan krug ritma. Akordi iz uvoda se vraćaju kao solo deo na sredini.
Prsti: Lik iz uvoda (solo deonica između akorda) je objašnjen u videu; nije zapisan na papiru.
Osećaj: Opušteno, ova pesma je lagana.

what.en: The slap, and lots of chords

en.new: The slap, and lots of chords
en.sub: A percussive slap inside the strum, plus Bm7, G7 and Cm. It's a lot of shapes, so take it a section at a time.
watch: Slapping too hard. It's a quick, light thud, then straight back into the up strum.
G7 to C to Cm in the chorus. Three quick changes in a row, and Cm is a barre.
Losing the pinky anchor. Keep it on the 3rd fret through G, G/B, Cadd9 and Am7.
practise: The slap over just a G until it feels natural.
Then the chorus change: G7, C, Cm, G.
other: G, G/B, Cadd9 and Am7 all keep your pinky on the 3rd fret of the thin e string. Cm is your Am shape with a barre, moved up to the 3rd fret.
It's the Stand By Me strum, but on the 3 you slap (X): bring the side of your strumming hand down onto the strings so they go quiet with a thud. One go per chord box.
Each box is one go of the strum. The new chords are in orange.
Feel: On the 3 you slap (X): bring the side of your strumming hand down onto the strings so they go quiet with a thud. A quick, light thud.

sr.sub: Udarac usred trzanja, plus Bm7, G7 i Cm. Mnogo je oblika, pa idi deo po deo.
watch: Preteran udarac. Brz je i lagan, pa odmah nazad u trzaj na gore.
G7 na C na Cm u refrenu. Tri brze promene zaredom, a Cm je barré.
Gubiš oslonac malog prsta. Drži ga na 3. pragu kroz G, G/B, Cadd9 i Am7.
practise: Udarac samo na G dok ne postane prirodan.
Onda promena u refrenu: G7, C, Cm, G.
other: G, G/B, Cadd9 i Am7 svi drže mali prst na 3. pragu tanke e žice. Cm je tvoj oblik Am sa barréom, pomeren na 3. prag.
To je ritam iz Stand By Me, ali na 3 ide udarac (X): spusti bok ruke kojom trzaš na žice da se utišaju uz tup zvuk. Jedan krug po kockici akorda.
Svaka kockica je jedan krug ritma. Novi akordi su narandžasti.
Osećaj: Na 3 ide udarac (X): spusti bok ruke kojom trzaš na žice da se utišaju uz tup zvuk. Brz, lagan tup udarac.

what.en: Travis picking

en.new: Travis picking
en.sub: Your thumb keeps a steady bass going on two strings, while your fingers pick in between.
watch: The thumb stopping. It keeps an even beat the whole time, even when your fingers get lost.
Thumb on the wrong strings. It follows the two thickest strings of each chord, so it moves when the chord does.
Rushing. It's a slow, gentle song. Let it breathe.
practise: Just the thumb on a C chord, A string then D string, until it's automatic. Then add the fingers one at a time.
other: G/B, G, Em7 and D/F# all keep your pinky or ring finger on the 3rd fret. D/F#: thumb (T) on the thick E string, and don't play the thin e.
Each box is one go of the Travis pattern. The solo section uses the verse chords.

Picking: T 1 T 2 T 1 T 2 on 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. T = your thumb, swapping between the two thickest strings of the chord (on C, that's the A then the D string). 1 = 1st finger on the G string. 2 = 2nd finger on the B string. The thumb never stops, the fingers fill the gaps. One go per chord box.

sr.sub: Palac drži ujednačen bas na dve žice, a prsti sviraju između.
watch: Palac staje. Drži ujednačen ritam sve vreme, čak i kad se prsti izgube.
Palac na pogrešnim žicama. Prati dve najdeblje žice svakog akorda, pa se pomera kad se pomeri akord.
Žurba. Spora je i nežna pesma. Pusti je da diše.
practise: Samo palac na akordu C, A žica pa D žica, dok ne postane automatski. Onda dodaj prste jedan po jedan.
other: G/B, G, Em7 i D/F# svi drže mali ili domali prst na 3. pragu. D/F#: palac (T) na debeloj E žici, a tanku e ne sviraj.
Svaka kockica je jedan krug Travis obrasca. Solo deo koristi akorde iz strofe.

Prsti: T 1 T 2 T 1 T 2 na 1 i 2 i 3 i 4 i. T = palac, smenjuje dve najdeblje žice akorda (na C to je A pa D žica). 1 = kažiprst na G žici. 2 = srednji na B žici. Palac nikad ne staje, prsti popunjavaju razmake. Jedan krug po kockici akorda.

what.en: Chords and melody at the same time

en.new: Chords and melody at the same time
en.sub: The finish line. Two note shapes that move up and down the neck, with the open G string ringing in between.
watch: Muting the open G. Keep your fingers arched so it rings the whole way through.
Losing the gap. The space between your two fingers stays the same as you slide.
Trying to learn it all at once. It's the hardest song in the course. A few bars a day.
practise: The walk up in the verse, one shape at a time: C, C#dim, D, D#dim, Em. Slow enough that every note rings.
other: The verse walks up the neck one fret at a time from C to Em, then back down. That walk is the heart of the song.
This song is your key to the secret level. The finish line. Post it and once I've seen it, I'll unlock the secret level for you.

Picking: Most shapes are just two fingers: one note on the A string (sometimes the thick E) and one on the B string. The G string stays open in between and rings through everything. Your thumb (T) picks the low note and your 1st finger plays the G and B strings together. Keep the same gap between your fingers and slide the shape up and down the neck.

sr.sub: Cilj. Oblici od dve note koji idu gore-dole po vratu, a otvorena G žica zvoni između.
watch: Prigušuješ otvorenu G. Drži prste povijene da zvoni sve vreme.
Gubiš razmak. Razmak između dva prsta ostaje isti dok klizaš.
Pokušavaš sve odjednom. Ovo je najteža pesma u kursu. Po nekoliko taktova dnevno.
practise: Penjanje u strofi, oblik po oblik: C, C#dim, D, D#dim, Em. Dovoljno polako da svaka nota zazvoni.
other: Strofa se penje uz vrat prag po prag od C do Em, pa nazad dole. To penjanje je srce pesme.
Ova pesma ti otključava tajni nivo. Cilj. Objavi je i kad je vidim, otključaću ti tajni nivo.

Prsti: Većina oblika je samo dva prsta: jedna nota na A žici (ponekad na debeloj E) i jedna na B žici. G žica ostaje otvorena između i zvoni kroz sve. Palac (T) svira donju notu, a kažiprst svira G i B žicu zajedno. Drži isti razmak između prstiju i klizi oblikom gore-dole po vratu.
